1.consolidated_definition: La roja y vistosa amapola de jardín presenta numerosas denominaciones regularmente distribuidas y ordenadas ... Al este se señala la zona de mapola entre Trujillo Alto, Caguas y Naguabo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The garden poppy, characterized by its vibrant red color and showy appearance, presents numerous designations regularly distributed and arranged ... To the east, the area known as "mapola" is indicated between Trujillo Alto, Caguas, and Naguabo.
